verdict.rationale: Apple documents official developer frameworks aimed at its silicon: Metal for Apple-designed GPUs, MLX for generative models on Apple Silicon, and Core ML for integrating models into apps. These are the chip family's own developer stack, comparable to a GPU vendor's SDK, but none is specific to the M4 Pro and the evidence offers little SDK depth. The llms.txt probe returned a 404, so there is no AI-agent-oriented developer documentation. missing for 10: M4 Pro-specific SDK documentation, AI-native machine-readable docs (llms.txt), independent or hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Metal puts the advanced capabilities of Apple-designed GPUs at your fingertips.
MLX is an open-source array framework that lets you experiment with, training, researching, and fine-tuning generative models on Apple Silicon.
Core ML delivers fast performance for integrating traditional machine learning models into your apps and games
